question: What is said to be destroyed when this form is held in meditation?
premises: This form is the object of ongoing meditation.
Old age and disease are present as a threat.
Old age and disease are destroyed in that case.
inference: Meditating on this form destroys old age and disease.
uncertainties: The mode of destruction is not specified here.
plain_english: When this form is meditated on, O goddess, old age and disease are destroyed.
